name: Hydrogen Line
summary: Hydrogen Line is a free-to-play, real-time space strategy MMO played in a web browser on PC or phone. Players start with a single planet, build mines and factories, research technologies and assemble fleets. From there they colonise further planets, trade resources with other players at the Exchange, raid rivals for resources and fight battles that are resolved round by round and written up in a battle report. Alliances can share espionage reports and launch joint attacks, and large battles leave wreckage that can form moons with buildings of their own. The game runs continuously in a shared, persistent universe, so fleets keep flying while a player is away.
